references.text: The same expression 'the one who hears the words of God' and 'sees visions from the Almighty' is repeated in Balaam's next oracle
God reveals himself as 'El Shaddai' (the Almighty) to Abraham; the same divine name is used here
Ezekiel also describes seeing 'visions from God' (מַחֲזֵה), a similar prophetic experience
A prayer for eyes to be opened to see wonderful things, related to 'open eyes' in Balaam's vision
Abraham fell into a deep sleep when God spoke to him, a state similar to Balaam who 'falls down'
Daniel fell into a deep sleep with his face to the ground during his vision, parallel to Balaam's experience
John fell as dead when he saw Christ in his glory, a similar prophetic experience
Peter fell into a trance and received a vision from God, parallel to Balaam's prophetic state
